A '''feather boa''' was a fashion accessory. At some point during his [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] career, [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] was imprisoned. The cell's other occupants were a [[Unidentified guard (Roark Garnet)|guard]] who was assigned to keep an eye on him and a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] named [[M-3PO (Jarstein)|M-3PO]]. Because he was restrained, Garnet instructed M-3PO to strangle the guard with a feather boa. Though the droid protested the use of such a device to "attack" a sentient being, he relented and proceeded to perform the task, which was ultimately foiled by M-3PO's politeness.<ref name="TRG1" />
